units.source_text: 夜色渐明。

en.t: The night gradually grew light.

units.source_text: 匂亲王的随从人来请主人动身返京。

en.t: Prince Niou's attendants came to ask their master to set out for the capital.

units.source_text: 右近此时才知道是匂亲王，便向他传达。

en.t: Only then did Ukon realize that it was Prince Niou, and she conveyed the message to him.

units.source_text: 匂亲王不想返京，他热爱浮舟，永无厌时，又念再到宇治，谈何容易，想道：

en.t: Prince Niou did not want to return to the capital; he loved Ukifune endlessly, and thinking how hard it would be to come again to Uji, he said to himself:

units.source_text: “不管京中如何扰攘地寻找我，至少今天我必须住在这里。

en.t: No matter how much turmoil there is in the capital as they search for me, at least today I must stay here.

units.source_text: 有道是‘生前欢聚是便宜’，今天就此告别，真要使我‘为恋殉身’了！”

en.t: They say that meeting joyfully while alive is the true gain; if we part today, I shall truly die for love!

units.source_text: 便召唤右近前来，对她说道：“我实在太不体谅人了！

en.t: He then summoned Ukon and said to her, I have truly been far too inconsiderate!

units.source_text: 不过今天我决计不回京去。

en.t: Even so, I am absolutely not going back to the capital today.

units.source_text: 你去安排我的随从人等在附近地方好好地躲避起来。

en.t: Go and arrange for my attendants to hide themselves carefully somewhere nearby.

units.source_text: 再吩咐我的家臣时方到京中去走一遭，有人问起我行踪时，回答说‘微行赴山寺进香了’，要巧妙对付。”

en.t: Also tell my retainer Tokikata to go to the capital, and if anyone asks where I am, have him answer skillfully that I went privately to worship at a mountain temple.

units.source_text: 右近听了又惊又气，想起昨夜太不小心，闯了这祸，懊恨不已。

en.t: Hearing this, Ukon was both shocked and angry, and she bitterly regretted the careless mistake of the previous night that had brought on this trouble.

units.source_text: 只得勉强镇静下来，想道：“事已如此，吵闹也是枉然，匂亲王面上又不好看。

en.t: She could only force herself to calm down and thought, Now that things have come to this, making a fuss is useless and would only embarrass Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 那天在二条院他见了小姐如此恋恋不舍，原来两人早有这不可逃避的宿世因缘。

en.t: That day at Nijo Palace he was so reluctant to part after seeing the young lady; it seems the two of them had an inescapable bond from former lives all along.

units.source_text: 这是不能怪人的了。”

en.t: This is no longer something one can blame anyone for.

units.source_text: 她如此自慰，答道：“今天京中派车子来迎接小姐呢。

en.t: Comforting herself in this way, she replied, Today a carriage has been sent from the capital to fetch the young lady.

units.source_text: 不知亲王在此有何主意？

en.t: I wonder what Your Highness intends to do here.

units.source_text: 你俩既有这不可逃避的宿世因缘，我等也无话可说了。

en.t: Since the two of you have this inescapable bond from former lives, we have nothing more to say.

units.source_text: 只是时候实在不巧。

en.t: Only, the timing is truly unfortunate.

units.source_text: 今天还请亲王回京为是。

en.t: For today, it would be best if Your Highness returned to the capital.

units.source_text: 如果有意，下次再请过来。”

en.t: If you still wish it, we will invite you again another time.

units.source_text: 匂亲王觉得她这话说得真漂亮，说道：“我魂思梦想了多时，头脑已经发昏，所以外人如何非难，我一概不懂，只知道定要如此。

en.t: Prince Niou thought she had spoken beautifully and said, I have dreamed of her for so long that my head is already clouded; whatever others may criticize, I understand none of it and only know that this must be so.

units.source_text: 稍能顾虑自己身份名誉的人，难道肯不避艰险，偷偷地到这里来么？

en.t: Would anyone who cared even a little for his rank and reputation brave such hardship and danger to come here in secret?

units.source_text: 京中来迎接，只要回报他们说：‘今天是禁忌日子，不宜出门。’

en.t: If they come from the capital to fetch her, simply reply, Today is a day of abstinence, and it is not suitable to go out.

units.source_text: 这是不可叫人知道的事，请你为我和她两人着想。

en.t: This is something that must not become known; please think of both me and her.

units.source_text: 别的事情都无须考虑了。”

en.t: There is no need to consider anything else.

units.source_text: 可知匂亲王此时已经迷恋浮舟，把世间一切讥评都忘记了。

en.t: It was clear that Prince Niou was already infatuated with Ukifune and had forgotten every criticism the world might make.

units.source_text: 右近便走出去，对催促动身的随从人员说：“亲王所言如此如此。

en.t: Ukon then went outside and said to the attendants who were urging departure, His Highness has said such and such.

units.source_text: 此事实在太不成样，还望你们劝谏一番。

en.t: This matter is truly outrageous, so I hope you will remonstrate with him.

units.source_text: 此种荒唐行为，即使他本人要做，你们这些随从人员也应该尽力谏阻，怎么可以糊里糊涂地引导他来呢？

en.t: Even if he himself wished to do something so absurd, you attendants should have done your utmost to stop him; how could you thoughtlessly guide him here?

units.source_text: 倘使这里的村夫俗子得罪了这位皇子，怎么得了！”

en.t: If some rustic person here were to offend this imperial prince, what would become of us!

units.source_text: 大内记心知此事的确糟透，哑口无言地站着考虑。

en.t: The Senior Secretary knew in his heart that the situation was indeed terrible, and he stood there silently thinking.

units.source_text: 右近又向他传言：“名叫时方的是哪一位？

en.t: Ukon then passed on another message to him: Which one of you is named Tokikata?

units.source_text: 亲王吩咐他如此如此。”

en.t: His Highness has instructed him to do such and such.

units.source_text: 时方笑道：“被你骂了一顿，我已经吓坏，即使亲王不吩咐，我也想逃走了。

en.t: Tokikata laughed and said, After being scolded by you, I am already terrified; even without His Highness's order, I would want to run away.

units.source_text: 老实告诉你：亲王这种荒唐行径，我们早已看清，大家都是拼着性命来的！

en.t: To tell you the truth, we understood long ago how reckless His Highness's behavior was; every one of us came here staking our lives!

units.source_text: 你们这里的值宿人员就要起身了，我赶快走吧。”

en.t: The night-duty people here will be getting up soon, so I had better hurry away.

units.source_text: 他立刻出去了。

en.t: He left at once.

units.source_text: 右近苦心考虑，如何可使家里的人不知道此事。

en.t: Ukon racked her mind over how to keep the people of the household from learning about this.

units.source_text: 这时候众侍女都已起身。

en.t: By this time all the gentlewomen had already risen.

units.source_text: 右近对她们说道：“大将出了些事情呢！

en.t: Ukon said to them, Something has happened to the Captain!

units.source_text: 昨夜回来时非常秘密。

en.t: When he returned last night, it was in great secrecy.

units.source_text: 看样子是途中碰到了匪徒吧。

en.t: It seems he must have run into bandits on the way.

units.source_text: 曾吩咐我：不要叫人知道，衣服等也须在夜间悄悄地送进去。”

en.t: He told me not to let anyone know, and said that clothes and other things must be quietly sent in during the night.

units.source_text: 侍女们说：“哎呀！

en.t: The gentlewomen said, Oh!

units.source_text: 真可怕啊！

en.t: How frightening!

units.source_text: 木幡山一带非常荒凉。

en.t: The area around Mount Kohata is terribly desolate.

units.source_text: 大概这回不像平时那样开路喝道，而是悄悄地经过，以致出了事情吧。

en.t: This time, he probably passed through quietly instead of having men clear the road and announce him as usual, and that must be why something happened.

units.source_text: 哎呀！

en.t: Oh!

units.source_text: 可怕极了！”

en.t: How utterly terrifying!

units.source_text: 右近说：“喂！

en.t: Ukon said, Hey!

units.source_text: 不要高声，静些儿吧。

en.t: Do not speak so loudly; please be a little quieter.

units.source_text: 被那些仆役们听见了一点风声，就不得了。”

en.t: If those servants hear even a hint of this, it will be disastrous.

units.source_text: 她如此骗过了众侍女，心里却非常着急：如果碰得不巧，大将的使者来了，怎么办呢？

en.t: In this way she deceived the gentlewomen, but inwardly she was terribly anxious: what would she do if, by ill luck, a messenger from the Captain arrived?

units.source_text: 便虔诚地祷告：“初濑观世音菩萨！

en.t: So she prayed devoutly, Bodhisattva Kannon of Hatsuse!

units.source_text: 保佑我们今天平安无事！”

en.t: Please protect us and let today pass safely!
